issue.title: `read_file` renders the empty-file reminder as line 1 of the file on `FilesystemBackend`

steps: Create an empty file named empty.txt using the shell, then read it using read_file. Report the exact tool result and whether any numbered source line was returned.
expected: An empty file yields an unnumbered empty-file reminder, not a fictitious line of file content.
defect: read_file presents System reminder: File exists but has empty contents with a line-number gutter.

fault location.explanation: FilesystemBackend returns the empty-file sentinel as nonempty content, so middleware may number it as source text. The issue was closed as not planned because of submission provenance, not because a fixing commit was identified.

Root cause: FilesystemBackend returns the empty-file sentinel as nonempty content, so middleware may number it as source text. The issue was closed as not planned because of submission provenance, not because a fixing commit was identified.
